'Reserving the guest memory arena' is required in every arm only as a sanity check that the log starts at boot, so an empty or truncated log cannot pass the forbids by default. Timed-arm logs are about 10 KB and never rotate. Runs with the hash log or slow_frame_log_ms rotate at about 5 MB (game.N.log, highest N oldest), so read every file.
